data.description:
## Summary
harvest-worktree.sh unconditionally requires a review-status artifact in the worktree artifacts directory. When enforcement.strategy=ci is set, per-worktree-review-commit.md Step 2 says to skip the entire review pipeline (classifier, reviewer dispatch, record-review). No review-status file is written in this path. As a result, harvest-worktree.sh exits 2 even though the pre-commit review gate already passed (via enforcement gate short-circuit).

## Reproduction
1. Set enforcement.strategy=ci in .claude/dso-config.conf
2. Run a sprint story through a sub-agent worktree
3. Skip the Step 2 review (per per-worktree-review-commit.md instructions)
4. Commit in the worktree (pre-commit review gate passes via enforcement gate)
5. Run .claude/scripts/dso harvest-worktree <worktree-branch> <artifacts-dir>
6. harvest-worktree exits 2: "ERROR: review-status not found"

## Expected Behavior
harvest-worktree.sh should detect enforcement.strategy=ci and skip the review-status check, mirroring the behavior of pre-commit-review-gate.sh which sources enforcement-gate.sh and exits 0 when strategy=ci.

## Root Cause
harvest-worktree.sh checks for allowlisted-files (SKIP_REVIEW=true) but does not check enforcement.strategy. pre-commit-review-gate.sh has `source enforcement-gate.sh; _dso_enforcement_gate_check && exit 0` at its top — harvest-worktree.sh has no equivalent.

## Fix
Add enforcement.strategy=ci check before the review-status block in harvest-worktree.sh (around line 196), mirroring pre-commit-review-gate.sh. Add a test in test-harvest-worktree.sh covering this path.
data.title: harvest-worktree.sh exits 2 when enforcement.strategy=ci because review-status is never written
